subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw make `deferred` a public cron/status/plugin-facing lifecycle contract in this PR, or split the internal yielded-parent repair from the public API/status expansion?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical line fix: the PR adds a persisted status value and plugin-visible lifecycle exports while changing Discord progress semantics, so maintainers must choose the supported contract and proof bar.

options.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
options.body: Keep this PR open until it has redacted Discord status/progress proof, upgrade compatibility proof, and maintainer acceptance of the public `deferred`/SDK surface.

options.title: Split The Public Surface
options.body: Ask for a narrower branch that keeps the internal yielded-parent repair separate from protocol, UI, CLI, and SDK status expansion.

options.title: Accept Contract Risk
options.body: Merge on source review, CI, and cron proof alone, accepting unproven Discord behavior and downstream client/plugin compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until it has redacted Discord status/progress proof, upgrade compatibility proof, and maintainer acceptance of the public `deferred`/SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and repo policy evidence place the product/API boundary decision closest to the subagent lifecycle and cron delivery ownership he has been carrying.
